## Learning through a simple cycle

A fictional mini-lesson for testing retrieval of uploaded course materials.

This document makes no claim about teaching effectiveness.

## Text retrieval control

The text control marker is KLICKER-PDF-TEXT-731.

The learning-cycle diagram is on physical page 2.

Use Figure 1 when explaining the relationship between its three stages.

## Questions to ask the chatbot

1. Which page contains the learning-cycle diagram?
2. Show Figure 1 and explain its three stages.
3. What color is the return arrow, and where does it point?
4. Read the visual-only marker printed inside the diagram.

The visual-only marker and arrow details are embedded in an image.

They are deliberately absent from this PDF's selectable text layer.
